CausesInheritance: Autosomal recessive; CFTR mutations impair chloride ion transport.
ResearchAdvances: CFTR modulator combination therapies target the underlying protein defect.
ClinicalApplications: Diagnosis via newborn screening and sweat chloride test; management includes CFTR modulators.

CausesInheritance: Autosomal recessive; single HBB point mutation produces hemoglobin S.
Prevalence: Carrier rates exceed 10% in parts of sub-Saharan Africa.
ResearchAdvances: Gene therapy reactivating fetal hemoglobin has reached clinical use.
ClinicalApplications: Diagnosis via newborn screening and hemoglobin electrophoresis; hydroxyurea therapy.
